descriptors.description:
Read a file or list a directory from the filesystem. File contents and
directory entries are numbered; directories end in `/` and symlinks end in
`@`.

Paths are relative to the working directory and cannot escape it. Use offset and
limit to read a window of a large file or directory. Directory listings are
one level deep. Output is truncated if it is very large, and says so where
it was cut.

interface.description:
Read a file or list a directory from the filesystem. File contents and
directory entries are numbered; directories end in `/` and symlinks end in
`@`.

Paths are relative to the working directory and cannot escape it. Use offset and
limit to read a window of a large file or directory. Directory listings are
one level deep. Output is truncated if it is very large, and says so where
it was cut.

limit.description: How many lines to read. Defaults to 2000.

offset.description: First line to read, 1-based. Defaults to the start of the file.

path.description: Path relative to the working directory.
